Vendor / remote.com hris cost

Remote.com pricing in 2026

Remote sells products rather than HRIS seats, and publishes a starting price for each one. Employer of Record starts at $599 per employee/month on annual contracts. Global Payroll starts at $19 per employee/month, US PEO at $99 per employee/month, and Contractor Management is $29 per contractor/month. The pricing page states there are no setup or onboarding fees. Remote publishes no standalone HRIS rate.

How the price is built

Remote sells products, not HRIS seats. The ledger prices Global Payroll at its starting price; EOR is full legal employment rather than an HRIS seat.

List cost at 100 employees, one year

  • Global Payroll (starting price): $22,800 ($19 x 100 x 12)

Before volume discounts, add-ons or any renewal increase. Run your own headcount in the ledger.

Is there a free Remote HRIS tier?

Not on the published pricing page. Remote lists paid products and no free plan. What the page does say is that HR Core, covering employee records, document management, time off, org charts and workflows, is included as standard with the EOR, Payroll and Contractor Management products. Remote HRIS is described as a richer paid layer on top of HR Core, with analytics, native integrations and customisable workflows, and no price attached.

What does Remote EOR cost per employee?

From $599 per employee/month on annual contracts, published as a starting price. The pricing page does not publish a per-country price table, so any country-specific pricing is something to confirm in a quote. The page states there are no setup or onboarding fees.

What does Remote Payroll cost?

Global Payroll starts at $19 per employee/month. The pricing page states there are no setup or onboarding fees and that the Remote platform is included on every plan.

When does Remote.com beat Deel or Oyster?

On published EOR starting prices, Remote and Deel both list from $599 per employee per month and Oyster lists USD 699, so Oyster is the dearest of the three on list and the choice between Remote and Deel turns on country coverage and service. For payroll on your own entities, Remote publishes a starting price ($19 per employee/month) and Deel publishes $29 for Payroll Global.

What does contractor management cost?

$29 per contractor/month for Contractor Management, which includes localised contracts, invoice approval, multi-currency payments and HR Core. Contractor Management Plus is $99 per contractor/month and adds indemnity cover up to $100,000 per contractor. Contractor of Record starts at $325 per contractor/month.
